headline: Fort Lewis and UCCS share the scoring lead
dek: UCCS's draw at home to Midwestern State was the first time they had conceded this season, and it left them level with Fort Lewis on twelve goals. Neither side has lost a match.
displaced_by: UCCS's draw with Midwestern State levels them with Fort Lewis on twelve goals; the standing dek's 'no other programme has scored as many' no longer holds.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is still concentrated at the top: Fort Lewis alone have outscored CSU Pueblo, MSU Denver, Colorado School of Mines, Regis and Adams State combined.

wire.line: Adams State have lost all three of their matches and are yet to score.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UCCS conceded their first goal of the season in the draw with Midwestern State, and remain unbeaten with twelve scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hugo Sjöberg's twelve saves for UCCS have come at the cost of a single goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: No match is a score gap today, but twelve have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Westminster have drawn all three of their matches, scoring five and conceding five.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: CSU Pueblo have won both their matches without conceding a goal.

last_match.line: UCCS's unbeaten start survives, but their clean record does not; Midwestern State had already beaten Colorado Mesa at home.

next_match.line: CSU Pueblo have yet to concede a goal, and only Fort Lewis have won more often in the conference.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
